extracted.intended_audience: prospective employees, volunteers, donors, and the general public interested in the American Red Cross marketing and communications team
extracted.subtask_description: A short organizational/team profile describing the responsibilities and expected outputs of the American Red Cross Marketing and Communications team, focused on messaging, media, digital channels, and community engagement to support disaster relief and humanitarian initiatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crafting and disseminating impactful messages
rubrics_metrics.description: The Marketing and Communications team ... is responsible for crafting and disseminating impactful messages that promote the organization's mission and services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on message creation and distribution aimed at promoting the American Red Cross' mission and services; implies clarity, relevance, and reach of messaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developing marketing strategies
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work involves planning and executing strategic marketing initiatives to support organizational goals (e.g., awareness, fundraising, volunteer recruitment).

rubrics_metrics.name: Overseeing visual communications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Responsibility for visual design and assets that represent the organization; implies consistency of brand visuals and design quality across materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overseeing digital communications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Management of digital channels and content (web, email, digital ads, online campaigns); implies attention to digital strategy, analytics, and channel-appropriate messaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Managing media relations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes handling press interactions, spokesperson coordination, and proactive/reactive outreach to journalists and outlets; important for accurate public coverage and crisis communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engaging the community through social media
rubrics_metrics.description: Engage with the community through social media ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use of social platforms to interact with audiences, distribute content, and build community; implies responsiveness, platform-appropriate content, and engagement metrics focus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engaging the community through direct outreach
rubrics_metrics.description: Engage with the community through ... direct outreach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offline and direct-channel engagement (events, local outreach, email/direct mail) to build relationships and encourage action among communities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Raising awareness
rubrics_metrics.description: This team plays a crucial role in raising awareness ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aim to increase public knowledge of the organization's work and needs; success likely measured by reach, impressions, and public recognition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Driving donations
rubrics_metrics.description: This team plays a crucial role in ... driving donations ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fundraising communications to encourage monetary support; implies persuasive messaging, donor journeys, and performance tracking for contributions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mobilizing volunteers
rubrics_metrics.description: Mobilizing volunteers to support disaster relief efforts and other humanitarian initiatives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communications and outreach designed to recruit, inform, and activate volunteers for operational needs; success measured by volunteer sign-ups and participation.
